theme: An open day in St. Pete with the Croatia clock ticking.
greeting: Kids are with you and Mike in St. Pete and the calendar is nearly clear — one afternoon call, and otherwise the day is yours. It's the last stretch before Croatia, so the open hours are best spent closing out the trip bookings that are still hanging.

needsAttention.title: Pick a new time with Conor Kehoe
needsAttention.detail: You asked to move Friday's PRI stewardship call off your plate; Conor's assistant came back with Monday Sept 7 (9:00-12:30 EDT) or Tuesday Sept 8 (9:00-11:30 EDT). It's waiting on you to choose one.

needsAttention.title: Croatia lodging still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: Two Sept-departure bookings are past due in Todoist and need to be done from dry land before Sept 8: the Cavtat hotel for the night of Sept 19, and the St. Pete landing-gap nights (Sept 20-22).

needsAttention.title: Get the checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued Croatia ticket shows zero checked bags on Basic Economy. Confirm the allowance on the Eurowings Discover site and pre-buy if needed — counter fees run far higher. Two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on.

flagged.title: NACD New England — Oct 28 prep session
flagged.detail: Larissa Ravetto looped you into a prep thread for the Oct 28 New England event; worth a read when you have a minute.

flagged.title: C&C Sprayfoam estimate — $12,450
flagged.detail: A QuickBooks estimate landed for review; due date is year-end, so no rush, but eyes on it.

flagged.title: St. Pete Airbnb check-in is live
flagged.detail: The Stunning St. Pete Ranch reservation (Sept 3-8) is confirmed and checked in.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters — Stewardship Digest, Italian Word of the Day, VA Vet Resources, and the Todoist daily digest.

recipe.title: Roast Monkfish
recipe.why: Early autumn wants something firm and warming — monkfish holds up as the season turns.

acts.line: The morning is unclaimed — the best use of it is the trip bookings that keep sliding.
One 30-minute Teams call with Brunswick at 3:30, then the day reopens.
Girls in residence and a full kitchen — a cook-from-scratch night before the travel churn resumes.
